question: What will be the closing value of the Nikkei 225 index (^N225 on Yahoo Finance) on September 3, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of ^N225 on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-03. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't find anything up to 2026-08-13 that settles this. The last close was 68,308.59 on Aug 13. That leaves 15 trading sessions before Sep 3, and each one moves the result.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Yahoo Finance ^N225 daily close for 2026-09-03, a Thursday and a normal Tokyo trading day. I couldn't open Yahoo's history page because the proxy refused the connection. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EN225/)
- 2026-08-13: the latest close was **68,308.59**, up 784.53 points (+1.16%). A market report, Armenpress and a search summary of FRED's NIKKEI225 series agree on this figure. [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/NIKKEI225), [Armenpress](https://armenpress.am/en/article/1257946)
- 2026-08-12: the previous close was 67,524.06. Aug 11 was a Japanese holiday (Mountain Day). [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/nikkei225)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The index sits at about 68,300, inside the 50,000 to 85,000 range and about 5.6% below the reported record.
- 2026-08-13: TOPIX closed at a record 4,176.04 (+0.89%), but the Nikkei did not set a record. [Armenpress](https://armenpress.am/en/article/1257946)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-13: the rise was led by chip and AI stocks. Reports also mention a weak yen and talk of a Bank of Japan (BOJ) rate hike. [KSA](https://www.ksa.com/economy/japan-topix-record-high-nikkei-chip-rally/)
- 2026-08-07: closed at 65,606.71 (-0.12%). The index had been weak for several sessions while regional markets did better. Earlier closes: Aug 6 at 65,683.26, Aug 5 at 66,300.44. [BBN Times/X](https://x.com/BBNTimes_en/status/2086578943176437973)
- Early Aug 2026: daily moves were large. Reuters, via NST, reported a jump of more than 3% on an AI rally and strong company outlooks, and a separate fall of about 2% (SoftBank -6.6%, Tokyo Electron -6.3%, Advantest -4.2%). The search summary tied these to Aug 5 and Aug 6, but the FRED closes above only show about -0.9% for Aug 6, so I couldn't pin down the dates. [NST jump](https://www.nst.com.my/amp/business/corporate/2026/08/1504491/japans-nikkei-jumps-over-3pct-ai-stock-rally-strong-corporate), [NST slump](https://www.nst.com.my/amp/business/corporate/2026/08/1505169/japans-nikkei-slumps-2pct-tech-shares-tumble-overwhelming)
- 2026-07-31: July close was 64,362.02, down 8.14% for the month. Year to date it was still up 27.86%. The fall came from a sell-off in AI and chip stocks: worries about US cloud giants' AI spending, Chinese competition and profit-taking. [SuMi TRUST](https://eu.sumitrust-am.com/docs/market-review-july-2026/download)
- 2026-06-30: June close was 70,062.32 (+5.62% for the month). [Nikkei Indexes](https://indexes.nikkei.co.jp/nkave/archives/file/nikkei_indexes_newsletter_vol79.pdf)
- 2026-06-25: the reported record close was 72,366.34. This comes from Macrotrends and I couldn't check it against Nikkei's own records. [Macrotrends](https://www.macrotrends.net/2593/nikkei-225-index-historical-chart-data)
- 2026-06-03: the index closed above 68,000 for the first time, driven by the AI boom. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/3/japans-stock-market-hits-new-record-as-ai-boom-gathers-steam)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- Recent monthly moves: June +5.6%, July -8.1%. From the July close to Aug 13 the index is up about 6.1%.
- Over roughly 3 weeks the index has swung widely. It went from about 72,400 (Jun 25) to about 64,400 (Jul 31), an 11% drop. Then it went from 65,607 (Aug 7) to 68,309 (Aug 13), +4.1% in four sessions.
- My own rough estimate, not taken from a source: daily moves of 1 to 3% suggest annualized volatility of about 25 to 35%. Over 15 sessions that gives a one-standard-deviation move of about 6 to 8.5%, or roughly ±4,000 to 5,800 points around 68,300. This is an assumption, not a measured figure.
- 2026 trend: strongly up, about +28% year to date at the end of July, with sharp drawdowns driven by AI and chip stocks.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the Sep 3, 2026 close.
- Kalshi runs hourly and daily Nikkei contracts (series KXNKY) and contracts on the year-end level (¥73,000 to ¥80,000 thresholds). An aggregator showed about 51% for "at least ¥70,000 in 2026", but the date of that snapshot is unclear. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxnky/nky-hourly/kxnky-26sep0702), [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/answer/nikkei)
- I found no recent sell-side target dated before Aug 13.

## 6. Upcoming events before Sep 3
- 2026-08-27 to 08-29: the Kansas City Fed's Jackson Hole symposium. Secondary sources say Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives the keynote on Aug 28, his first there as chair. That speech time is not confirmed on the Kansas City Fed's site. [KC Fed FAQ](https://www.kansascityfed.org/research/jackson-hole-economic-symposium/jackson-hole-faqs/), [Regards of Wall Street](https://www.regardsofwallstreet.com/news/jackson-hole-2026-dates-schedule-warsh-first-speech)
- Mid/late Aug: Japan's Q2 preliminary GDP, Japan's July CPI and the US July CPI/PCE releases. I couldn't confirm the exact 2026 dates.
- Late Aug: Nvidia's quarterly earnings, which usually come out in late August (date not confirmed). This matters because the Nikkei has been closely tied to AI and chip stocks such as Advantest, Tokyo Electron and SoftBank.
- Ongoing: the yen exchange rate and speculation about a BOJ hike. The next BOJ policy meeting is in mid-September, after resolution, but comments from BOJ officials before then could move the market.
- 2026-09-01 to 09-03: US ISM manufacturing data and the run-up to the US August jobs report (Sep 4, after resolution).
